verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair openness question for a SaaS equity-management platform, but the evidence pack contains no self-hosted, on-premises, or open-source deployment option for AngelList. The documentation describes only hosted dashboard workflows. The Open Cap Table Format export is data portability, an adjacent feature that is not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
